content.text: The spread order is reversed: the existing entity overrides the payload.

candidates.explanation: The merge is `{...payload, ...UserMapper.toDomain(entity)}`. The existing entity is spread last, so its current values overwrite every field in the payload (firstName, lastName, role, etc.). The save then writes the unchanged data and returns it, so the API gives 200 OK with the old values and the database stays the same.

fix.description: Swap the spread order so the payload overrides the existing entity: `{...UserMapper.toDomain(entity), ...payload}`.
